newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close above 1,500 points.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close above 1,500 points.

text.p: The Karachi stock index closed above 1,500 points on Monday on institutional support and selective buying by investors after the government said it would announce a relief package for stock markets, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 9.97 points, or 0.67 percent, to close at 1,500.04. Gainers beat losers 171 to 114.
"The relief package for the textile sector had a good impact on the market," a dealer at Taurus Securities said.
Dewan Salman Fibres rose 1.50 rupees to 33.75 and Gadoon Textile gained 2.50 to 42.50.
